g.text: Zephyr lessons for nxrs: contracts, ownership and evidence
Z6 · left/center: nxrs design direction · right: questions borrowed from Zephyr, not an RTOS port
Borrow configuration, data-lifetime and lifecycle discipline. Apply the lessons on NuttX; do not add a Zephyr deployment goal.
BLUE solid = API call | TEAL solid = data / ownership | ORANGE dashed = wake / schedule | GREY dotted = build / review relation
